name: Topps Update Series — Base Set (All Teams)
notes: Full Topps Update Series base set, all 30 teams, 350 cards in card-number order (base only — add a parallel to any card from its page). Checklist from My Card Batch, cross-checked with Dugout Vault (no conflicts on numbers, players or teams) and SportsCardsPro. Reference photos and raw prices via SportsCardsPro.
